about: Every remark the coach makes in plain words, in one place. Edit the lines, keep the keys. Rage mode lines (rage.moves): each situation has a chance (0–1: how often a line pops on that kind of card) and lines with a weight (1 rare, 2 normal, 3 common). Situations are checked top to bottom (rage.ts), the first match wins. Mild mode halves the chances and skips lines with swearing. Same move, same result every time; at most one line per 10 s of a round. Swear at the play, never the person: no slurs, no sexual insults, no countries or races, no real people. Tips: the one-line advice next to each habit on the profile and in the recap.

lines.text: You killed your own teammate. The enemy says thanks.
Wrong team, genius.
Friendly fire isn't a strategy.
Cowboy.
They didn't even have to try that round.

teamFlashDied.when: Team-flashed a teammate who then died (??)

lines.text: You flashed him, they killed him. Assist for the enemy.
Blinded your own teammate straight into a death. Incredible support.
Your flash got a kill. Wrong team.
Next time just tell him to close his eyes and walk out.
Call your fucking flashes.
Your team saw white. The enemy saw nothing.
Pop flash for the wrong team. Again.
Your teammates would like to see the game too.

ecoDeath.when: Died to an eco with full gear

lines.text: They had pistols. You had everything. And you still died.
Full buy, died to a Glock. Learn how to shoot.
That gear was gift-wrapped for them.
They saved money. You donated yours.

noTrade.when: Didn't trade a teammate who died nearby

lines.text: They died two seconds away from you. Two seconds. Trade them!
Your teammate died for nothing. You were right there.
Trade. Your. Teammates.
You watched him die like it was a stream.

lostToBlind.when: Killed by an enemy who was flashed

lines.text: He was blind. BLIND. And you still lost.
The flash did its job. You didn't.
He couldn't see you. You still lost the duel. Think about that.

knifeOut.when: Died with the knife or a grenade out (not when outgunned)

lines.text: Knife out in a gunfight. Bold.
Running with the knife out? They were waiting.
Bringing a knife to a gunfight is a saying, not a plan.
Nice shot.
A whole spray and not one hit.
The wall behind him took more damage than he did.
Exceptional shooting.
Aim at the head. Or the body. Or anything.
The AWP was the round. Now it's theirs.
You dropped the AWP. They're using it now.
Expensive gift. With a scope.
You paid for that utility. Throw it, you hoarder.
Died with grenades in your pocket. They're not souvenirs.
Throw it before you die, not never.

dryPeek.when: Peeked a held angle with no flash or info

lines.text: Wide peek, no flash, dead. Classic.
You swung into a held angle. He was waiting.
Flash first. Peek second.
Don't trust your gut. Trust a flash.

lowHp.when: Died taking a fight on low HP

lines.text: Taking that fight on low HP? Sit the fuck down.
You were one tap from dead and you still peeked.
Low HP means hide, not hero.

loud.when: Died after running loud near enemies

lines.text: Shift exists. Use it.
They heard you coming from spawn.
Running into the site like a marching band.
Footsteps are information. You gave it away for free.
Shooting while running. This isn't Call of Duty.
Stop. Then shoot. It's not that hard.
Counter-strafe. Then shoot. Then win.
Empty mag, full confidence. Great combo.
Reload before the fight, not during it.
Click. Click. Dead.
First blood, and it's yours. Again.
Five seconds in and you're already dead. Great start.
Free first kill for them. Again.
Entry fragging works better with the frag part.

isolated.when: Died alone, nobody near to trade

lines.text: Why the fuck did you go there alone?
Where was your team? Not there.
Lone wolf, short life.
Nobody could trade you. Nobody could even see you.
He shot you through a wall. He knew exactly where you were.
Standing still on the one spot everybody sprays. Great.
Pre-aimed spots get pre-fired.
They were spraying the smoke and you walked into it anyway.
Free kill through the smoke. For them.
Walking through a sprayed smoke is a coin flip. You lost it.
Nice grenade. It hit absolutely nothing.
WOW, a million damage to bricks.
That flash blinded the floor.
Throw it where the enemy is. Not where he was yesterday.

overRotation.when: Rotated away from a site that needed you

lines.text: You left your site wide open to go help nobody.
Everyone rotated. Including you. Why?
You left your site to watch your team die somewhere else.

badPosition.when: Engine: a mistake or blunder in where you went (? / ??)

lines.text: Why the fuck did you go there?
Literally anywhere else was better. The engine checked.
That spot has a death rate. You just added to it.
Not terrible. Not good either. Why there?
A level-10 player wouldn't have. Just saying.
Close. Not quite.

wallbang.when: Got a kill through a wall (not a plain one)

lines.text: Through the wall. Okay, I see you.
Wallbang. Fine, that one was smart.
Through the wall. I'll allow it.

smokeKill.when: Got a kill through a smoke (not a plain one)

lines.text: Through the smoke. Lucky or smart, I'll take it.
Spraying the smoke actually worked for once.
Okay. That was actually filthy.
Who are you and what did you do with the player from the last round?
Clip it. Nobody will believe you.
Are you okay? That was actually good.
Fine. That one was good. Don't get used to it.
Look at you doing something right for once.
Don't let it go to your head.
What the fuck was that?
That lost the round. Just so you know.
Watch that one. Then watch it again.
I need a minute after that one.
What was that supposed to be?
Bad. Just bad. Watch it again.
That cost you. Small, but it adds up.
Two of them, one of you. You fought anyway.
Count heroes. Then fight.
Brave. Wrong, but brave.

dlUltReady.when: Deadlock: died with the ultimate ready

lines.text: You died with your ultimate ready. Press it.
Saving the ult for the respawn screen?
Your ult had a whole fight to shine. It stayed home.

dlObjectiveLost.when: Deadlock: an objective fell right after the death

lines.text: You died, and the Walker went with you.
That death cost a whole building.
Alive defends towers. Dead doesn't.
Past their Guardian, alone. Bold choice.
That's their base. They live there.
No way back. You knew that.

dlHotSpot.when: Deadlock: died at a spot high-rank players die at

lines.text: High-rank players die there all the time. Now so do you.
That spot is famous. For deaths.

dlRicherKill.when: Deadlock: killed a much richer hero

lines.text: Killed someone way richer. That one hurt them.
Expensive kill. Nice.
Three kills in ten seconds. Okay, monster.
Who gave you permission to be good?
Solo kill against three. Clip it.
Outnumbered and still won. Fine, I'm impressed.
Waited so long it became a 1v5. Great job.
The round was lost by the time you showed up.

summary.untradedDeaths: You keep dying where nobody can trade you. Play WITH your team, for fuck's sake.
summary.isolatedDeaths: Stop running off alone. Every time you go solo, you die solo.
summary.openingDeaths: You give away the first kill every other round. Stop being the free opening.
summary.whiffs: You miss sprays you should hit. Stop, aim, then shoot.
summary.unusedUtil: You die with your grenades every round. THROW THEM.
summary.wastedFlashes: Your flashes blind nobody. Learn one good flash per spot.
summary.teamHarm: You hurt your own team more than the enemy does. Call your utility.
summary.awpLost: You keep losing the AWP. That's $4,750 a pop. Play it safer.
summary.lowHpFights: You take fights on low HP like you're immortal. You're not.
summary.adr: Your damage is a joke. Get into fights that matter.
summary.kast: Half the rounds you did nothing. Be useful.
summary.hs: Aim at the head. That round thing on top.
summary.trades: Your teammates die and you don't trade. Swing!
summary.impact: You barely change rounds. Kills that matter, please.
summary.side: One side you play fine, the other you throw. Fix it.
summary.none: Honestly? Not bad. Don't make me say it twice.
summary.dlSurvival: You die more than anyone in your role. Stay alive, then make plays.
summary.dlRotations: Your lane doesn't need you all game. Rotate, gank, come back.
summary.dlAbilities: Your abilities do the damage. Use them every fight.

tips.untradedDeaths: Fight where a teammate can trade you: push with someone a step behind, or from a spot a teammate sees.
tips.isolatedDeaths: When you push alone and it fails, nobody can trade. Keep the aggression, but take it where a teammate can follow.
tips.openingDeaths: The first death of the round costs most: take the first fight with a flash, or let the entry go first.
tips.whiffs: Sprays that miss: stop before shooting, burst at range, and reset instead of spraying on the move.
tips.unusedUtil: You die with grenades in your pocket: throw something into a fight you're about to take.
tips.wastedFlashes: Flashes that blind nobody: pop them over the angle you're about to peek, for yourself or called for a teammate.
tips.teamHarm: Your utility hurts teammates: call your flashes, and throw them where your team isn't looking.
tips.awpLost: You lose the AWP often: after a shot, move back instead of re-peeking the same angle.
tips.lowHpFights: You take fights already hurt: reset, wait for the trade, or play for information.
tips.adr: Damage per round: get into more fights that matter, with utility first.
tips.kast: Rounds where you did something (kill, assist, survive, traded): stay alive and tradeable.
tips.hs: Headshots: keep your crosshair at head height while moving, and stop before the shot.
tips.utilDamage: Grenade damage: HEs and mollies on spots enemies hold or cross (they also soften fights).
tips.flashAssists: Flashes that win fights: flash for a teammate's peek, not only for your own.
tips.trades: Trading teammates: stay close enough to swing when one dies; the window is about 2 s.
tips.impact: Win chance you add per round: plays that change rounds, not just kills.
tips.loud: You run near enemies: shift-walk within about 20 m of where an enemy could be. They hear you coming.
tips.react: Reaction: hold angles you expect them on, crosshair already there, so you react instead of searching.
tips.aim: Crosshair placement: pre-aim where heads appear (corners, boxes) while you move.
tips.stopped: Counter-strafe: stop (tap the opposite key) before the first shot.
